requires.note: Complete converted Warcraft II data tree

instructions:
Use the upstream wargus extractor on your original Warcraft II installation on the computer. Copy the complete output tree to /sd/roms/wargus.

Run verify_wargus_data.py and the matching PAX audio/video preparation tools from pax-recipe/tools. An archive of original game files alone is not prepared runtime data.

These variants are preserved source ports; their complete playable PAX builds are not currently verified.
